component.name: Glimpse
component.summary: Modern, predictable Linux video player built with GTK4 and Rust

description.p: Glimpse is a Linux media player with a GTK4 and libadwaita interface, an in-process FFmpeg playback engine, and native PipeWire audio output. It supports embedded audio-track selection, embedded and external text subtitles, synchronized playback, whole-file and A-B looping, seeking, volume control, playback speed, video rotation, screenshots, and fullscreen playback.

Polishes the playback menus and volume controls, improves playback-speed controls, adds keyboard shortcuts for screenshots and speed adjustment, and refines the loading-page and main-menu presentation.

Adds adjustable playback speed, video rotation, screenshot capture, and software volume amplification up to 150%. Also refines the volume control and positions Glimpse as a GNOME Showtime alternative.

Adds embedded and external text subtitle support, whole-file and A-B playback looping, improved seekbar navigation, and more robust seeking at the end of media. Also reduces repetitive FFmpeg metadata warnings.
Introduces the in-process FFmpeg playback engine with native PipeWire audio output, audio-track selection, and improved playback synchronization.
